record.question: At present, how many Union territories are there in India?
record.explanation: Answer C: Nine. As of the paper’s November 2019 date, the two new Union Territories of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh had taken effect on 31 October. India had seven UTs before that change, so the count was nine. This is option (c), index 2; do not substitute today’s count. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressreleasePage.aspx?PrId=1590112&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
